gen-dafont-college-gf-cossette-texte: Every curve in College is as thick as a straight stem, which gives its tall lowercase a stamped, authoritative punch. Cossette Texte follows in a sans-serif with a wide-eyed e and a prominent x-height, easy to settle into.
gen-dafont-college-gf-duru-sans: College traces a constant-width outline you could follow with a fingertip, with large counters opening up its tall lowercase. Duru Sans reads low and wide, its bodies dominating each line while ascenders barely rise.
gen-dafont-college-gf-gafata: College looks cut by an engraver at a single depth, every curve as thick as its stems and its tall lowercase wide open. Gafata sits in sans-serif quiet, a tall band of letters with short stalks.
gen-dafont-college-gf-hind-madurai: College hits with curves as thick as its straight stems and big counters in a tall lowercase. Hind Madurai then settles things down, its s curves opening wide and its lowercase filling the line like capitals, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-college-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri lifts its x-height skyward, with rounded sans-serif letters that stay open and inviting. And College, with stems and crossbars sharing one thickness, earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-dafont-college-gf-khula: College draws a skeleton outline in one fixed stroke thickness, with big counters throughout its tall lowercase. Khula does the opposite job, its squat brush-pen belly and curves holding their mouths open for steady, easy reading.
gen-dafont-college-gf-miriam-libre: College draws every curve as thick as a straight stem, its tall lowercase full of big counters. Miriam Libre carries the weight of drawn wire, with generous openings in its s, so extended reading feels friendly and sturdy.
gen-dafont-college-gf-montserrat-underli: Big counters in a tall lowercase, every curve as thick as a stem: that is College at a glance. Montserrat Underline lets its counters breathe like a hollow reed, with round bowls and oversized lowercase, so extended reading flows without friction.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mozilla-text: Chunky, stamped, sure of itself: College draws every bowl as heavy as its stems. Mozilla Text feels bolder than it is, its tall bodies and flared terminals sitting beside that heavy heading like a lively sans-serif companion.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic leaves an open, welcoming gap in the c and keeps capitals only slightly above lowercase. College does the loud work, with no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye.
